member.name: T:SysWeaver.CompressProgram
member.summary:
Shader optimization (.glsl / .frag).
A minimized shader must work exactly like the original in Effect Weaver (Effect Saver, Effect Vj, the shader editor), so everything its shader parser (EffectWeaver.Common ShaderParser) reads from the source is kept (unless RemoveShaderVars is set):
The tunable variable candidates: "#define NAME literal" (top level or in an "#ifndef NAME" guard) and "const T NAME = literal;" with a comment, each on its own line with its comment (comment continuation lines are joined, "var: {...}" annotations are compacted). The candidates are found with the parser's rules (mirrored here), names defined more than once are no candidates.
The iMouse channel comments ("// iMouse.x = Name | Description | Default"), as compact lines at the top.
The entry points (main, mainImage and vertexMain, the optional vertex stage).
The shader is stripped: comments and white space removed, short number literals, nothing renamed or evaluated (exactly the same code). With MinifyShaders it's also preprocessed (comments removed, macros expanded, conditionals evaluated) and minified (shader_minifier), with the candidates hidden from both and put back afterwards, and that is used if it's smaller. Not possible if a kept define is used by a preprocessor conditional (directly or through another macro, evaluating it would remove the variable's effect), for a local candidate const, short candidate names (the minifier's names could clash) or if a candidate is lost on the way. shader_minifier's rewrites can break a shader (renders black / hangs the GPU), so MinifyShaders results must be verified.
